test.result: 41 passed (exit code 0); Ruff and mypy on Kite event normalization passed.

implemented: Kite event normalization never substitutes receipt time for a missing source timestamp; malformed/missing timestamps are rejected or durably reason-coded.
Received events explicitly reject source timestamps in the future, record source timestamp age, and support a caller-supplied non-negative source-specific maximum age.
Tests cover source-age tolerance, future source clocks, missing/invalid timestamps, source-local naive Kite timestamps, and reversed ingest/receipt clocks.
blockers: The existing live intraday caller does not yet provide a source-specific maximum-age policy, so old Kite timestamps can still be admitted when the optional tolerance is omitted.
The provider timestamp's exact semantics can vary between last trade time and quote/depth capture time; policy must account for feed type before this becomes a universal fill gate.
scope_note: Timestamp validity and configurable staleness checks are implemented at the Kite event boundary; full production enforcement remains incomplete until the live caller pins a feed-specific tolerance and execution gates consume it.
